purpose: Fresh independent Compose instruction reserve S, frozen before production export or model generation.
evaluationOrder: Record and grade the first outputs before changing production behavior in response to them.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: Fourteen contentful cases produce usable messages or coding prompts with addressees, facts, conditions, uncertainty, recipient restrictions and exact literals intact. Two source-free transformations are rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: A writer direction or superseded fact enters the message, a recipient or restriction is omitted, a number or timezone changes, uncertainty or a condition is lost, a technical or quoted literal changes, action is falsely claimed, or a source-free transform becomes review-ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: A different but faithful paraphrase or weak style change that retains all operative meaning.
semanticCriteria.gate: All fourteen contentful cases review-ready with zero critical errors, four explicit tone or length directions visibly applied, and both source-free cases rejected before review.
